messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] GPU pool 'rw-gpu-prod' queue depth > 10k for 2m, token inflow spike, autoscaler failed to add nodes: ASG scale attempt error (LimitExceeded). Pager triggered. https://rwd.inc/alerts/3601236789
ryan_oncall: Paging in. I'm loading the runbook. Anyone oncall infra?
ashley_infra: here, looking at autoscaler logs now. seeing repeated failures: 'CreateFleet error: LaunchTemplateNotSupported' then 'AttachRoleDenied: sts:AssumeRole' for nodegroup role.
marta_sre: stack: k8s-cluster-a, nodegroup autoscaling via cluster-autoscaler -> asg rw-gpu-asg-prod (min=4, max=20), current desired=20. ASG reports at max, scale request rejected.
lina_support: Customer ops ping — a few customers reporting timeouts on large-batch embedding jobs, support ticket queue growing. ETA for mitigation?
sam_ops: On it, collecting affected customers list. Proposing immediate mitigations: 1) reduce batch size on queued jobs 2) mark low-priority pods with evictable taint to free GPU slots 3) if needed, bump ASG max.
ryan_oncall: OK, can we verify why ASG didn't scale earlier? Ashley, what does the autoscaler say about attachrole/launch template?
ashley_infra: paste logs:
```
I0603 18:07:12 autoscaler.go:123] Attempting to scale up: nodegroup rw-gpu-asg-prod
E0603 18:07:13 aws_manager.go:456] CreateInstance error: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
status code: 403, request id: abc-def-123
caused by: PassRole policy denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AutoscalerRole
```
ashley_infra: Also seeing launch template version on ASG = 2 but AMI referenced by LTv4 (mismatch) — new node creation fails validation in our cloud account due to image deprecation check.
marta_sre: So two blockers: ASG at max, IAM PassRole denied, and LT/AMI mismatch. Any quick wins?
sam_ops: Quick wins: 1) temporarily bump ASG max from 20 -> 30 (requires infra approval) 2) patch AutoscalerRole to allow iam:PassRole -> needs perms change 3) create fallback nodegroup with different LT that works.
ryan_oncall: I'll approve ASG max bump if infra confirms it won't hit quota. Ashley, can you check account EC2 quota for GPU instances and whether we can go to 30?
ashley_infra: Checking quotas... current GPU instance quota in region = 40, used = 18, bump to 30 OK. I'll open console and adjust ASG max to 30 now.
eng-release: Heads-up — if we add more nodes we may hit capacity-related scheduling regressions for realtime customers. Recommend we enable pod priority preemption for batch workloads to avoid impact.
lina_support: Customer-success-jade just posted in #support: several orgs reporting inference latency spikes ~45-120s and some 503s. We're escalating high-importance tickets.
ryan_oncall: Doing mitigations in parallel: Ashley -> ASG max bump, Marta -> prepare eviction taint job to drain noncritical pods, Sam -> throttle batch ingestion and reroute critical traffic to dedicated pool.
ashley_infra: ASG max updated to 30 (console change id: console-req-998). Attempting scale now.
ashley_infra: AWS responding: new instance launch failing still due to PassRole denial; autoscaler can't assume AutoscalerRole to create instances with instance-profile. Need IAM policy update.
marta_sre: Can we manually create nodes via infra service account to buy time? I can create 2 node instances with working LT v4 and register them to cluster. Would that help?
ashley_infra: Yes, manual boot with LT v4 works. I'll create 3 additional nodes into rw-gpu-asg-prod using LT v4 to temporarily raise desired count. Doing now.
ashley_infra: Manual instances launched and joined cluster. Nodes: gpu-spot-101, gpu-spot-102, gpu-spot-103. kubelet registered.
sam_ops: Eviction job running to drain noncritical batch pods from GPUs to free up space for realtime pods. patch applied: `kubectl label nodes --selector=role=batch evictable=true` then `kubectl adm drain ...`
ryan_oncall: Support, confirm whether customers seeing improvements. Lina?
lina_support: Early signs good — latency for affected calls dropping to ~20-30s for some customers. Tickets updated.
ashley_infra: IAM fix required: AutoscalerRole missing iam:PassRole for instance-profile ARN arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/InstanceProfileForNodes. Created policy change PR: https://git.internal/infra/iam/pulls/4567. Need approver.
eng-release: I'll review PR, approve if tests pass. In meantime, autoscaler needs restart after role update.
marta_sre: Also fixed launch template mismatch: updated ASG to use LT v4 consistently (LT id: lt-0abcdv4). That removed image validation failures.
ryan_oncall: Great. Plan summary: 1) manual nodes up to relieve queue 2) ASG max bumped to 30 3) LT set to v4 4) IAM PR for PassRole in progress 5) throttle batch ingestion and evict low-priority pods.
customer-success-jade: On customer side: notified top-10 impacted accounts, offered extended credits and a ticket contact. They're tracking recovery.
ashley_infra: IAM PR merged and applied at 18:53 UTC. Restarting cluster-autoscaler to pick up creds.
marta_sre: Restarted autoscaler pod `cluster-autoscaler-xyz` and watching logs. Now it successfully calls CreateFleet and launches new nodes.
ashley_infra: New nodes provisioning healthy: gpu-prod-104..gpu-prod-109. Desired now 27. ASG capacity now 27/30.
nina_temp: (bot) Incident timeline updated in incident tracker: https://incidents.rwd/3601236789
ryan_oncall: Support, please do final customer impact tally and send post-incident summary to customers with remediation steps. Lina, Jade?
lina_support: Tallying now. Preliminary: 8 orgs affected, peak error rate +15% for embeddings/real-time; median additional latency 35s; no data loss. Will draft communication.
sam_ops: Queue metrics show steady decline; backlog down from 10.2k -> 600 in 35m.
eng-release: Rolling patch to reduce default batch size for queued jobs pushed as temporary config to 3 services to reduce pressure.
ryan_oncall: Great work. I'm handing off to Marta (SRE) for postmortem. I'll update pager and mark incident as mitigated at 18:59 UTC but keep page open for followup. :thumbsup:
marta_sre: Taking postmortem. Immediate actions for PM: 1) add IAM lint to PR checks 2) autoscaler should verify LT version compatibility before attempting scale 3) add ASG soft-warning when approaching max (alert at 80% of max) 4) runbook add manual node bootstrap steps.
customer-success-jade: Customers updated, most satisfied with remediation and credits offer. one customer wants SLA credit form — handed to billing.
ryan_oncall: Closing active mitigation, leaving follow-ups in #postmortems. Thanks everyone.
marta_sre: Creating postmortem ticket: INC-3601236789-pm, linking logs and runbook.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED by ryan_oncall at 3601240500
